journey.name: Create a deck from the editor — the announce prompt has to be answered
journey.description:
The first-deck path, which no other journey covered and which is why #193's sibling bug lived on iOS: the "Create a deck" entry exists only in the *empty* library state, so an account that already owns a deck cannot reach it at all.
The trap is the announce prompt. `shareOnPubky` defaults on, so a save that *creates* a deck parks on "Share this on Pubky?" and withholds the save-success signal until it is answered — a screen that never renders the prompt looks like Save did nothing while the deck is already written on the homeserver, and tapping Save again writes a second one.
Requires a signed-in account with **no decks**. Answer the prompt with "Not now" so the run posts nothing; "Don't ask again" would turn announcing off for every later journey.

actions.action: Launch the Loopky app signed in to an account that owns no decks, and tap the element with resource-id "tab_decks"
Verify the empty library offers a create action, and tap it
Verify the deck editor opens with an empty title and a Save control
Type "Journey 24 deck" into the title field and tap Save
Verify a "Share this on Pubky?" prompt appears offering Share, "Don't ask again" and "Not now" — all three visible (regression: on iOS the prompt was never rendered and the editor simply stayed put)
Verify the editor closes and the new deck's detail screen is shown (regression: the editor stayed on screen with the deck already saved)
Go back to the Decks tab and verify "Journey 24 deck" appears exactly ONCE (a second tap on Save while stuck used to create a duplicate)
Delete "Journey 24 deck" so the account is empty again for the next run
